clauses.title: Current registry evidence
clauses.text: An electronics supplier may enter comparison only when a current registry record identifies the exact supplier ID. Similar legal or trading names are not evidence of the same supplier.

clauses.title: Identity ambiguity
clauses.text: A supplier-name collision, alias mismatch, or missing supplier identifier requires human review and must not be resolved by fuzzy similarity alone.

clauses.title: Part-level RoHS evidence
clauses.text: Current RoHS evidence must match the confirmed supplier ID and the requested manufacturer part number. Evidence for a related part or similarly named supplier is insufficient.

clauses.title: Unknown compliance
clauses.text: Missing, expired, or conflicting compliance evidence remains review required; it must not be inferred from quotation language.

clauses.title: Manager approval threshold
clauses.text: A proposed award with confirmed landed cost of SGD 9,500.00 or more requires recorded manager approval before publication.

clauses.title: Approval evidence
clauses.text: Approval evidence must identify the approving actor, approved amount, timestamp, and exact task revision. A prior-revision approval is stale.
